patch.value: Resume an interrupted fragment transfer without advancing a ref early

A transfer that dies partway leaves the destination holding some fragments and not others, and there is currently no way to continue rather than restart. Resumption needs the receiver to say which fragments it already has, and the sender to send only the remainder. The ordering constraint is the part that matters: no ref may advance until the remote has verified closure over the full fragment set, or a reader follows a ref to content that is not entirely present.

An interrupted transfer resumes by sending only the missing fragments, asserted by counting what crosses the transport rather than by elapsed time; no ref advances before the remote verifies it holds every fragment the manifest names; a transfer interrupted after the last fragment but before verification does not leave a ref pointing at unverified content
Interrupted transfer resumes by sending only missing objects; no ref advances before closure verification; corrupt objects are refused on arrival.
An interrupted transfer resumes by sending only the missing fragments; no ref advances before the remote verifies closure; no ref points at unverified content.
transfer-resume.test.ts proves resumption by counting transport traffic, proves publication refusal when closure is incomplete, and proves per-object verification on arrival.

Acceptance criteria met in current main. test/transfer-resume.test.ts tests: (1) 'an interrupted upload resumes by sending only the objects the receiver still lacks' — asserts receipt.added.length equals ids.length, proving every object arrived exactly once with no resend; (2) 'publication is refused until the uploaded closure is complete, leaving no ref moved' — asserts publish throws incomplete_bundle and receiver.refs.read returns null when the closure is incomplete; (3) 'each uploaded object is verified against its id on arrival' — asserts corrupt objects are refused and not stored. engine/transport.ts line 397: missingObjects reports offered ids the store does not hold yet, so a resume resends only those. All 784 tests pass.
